title: Theft from Shared Room and Private Room Listings under Host Damage Protection (HostCover)
content:
Theft from a listing in shared space is settled in part under **Host Damage Protection (HostCover)**. The theft access share follows the space type of the listing the plan covers, as recorded for that listing in Listings: theft from a Shared Room listing is settled at 50 percent, theft from a Private Room listing at 75 percent, and theft from a listing of any other space type in full. The percentage applies to the theft loss being settled, before any guest payment or deductible comes off it.

| Space type of the covered listing (Listings) | Theft settled at |
|---|---|
| Shared Room | 50 percent |
| Private Room | 75 percent |
| Entire Guest Suite | in full |
| Entire Apartment | in full |
| Entire Home | in full |
| Luxury Villa | in full |

## Questions the clause answers

**Which listing's space type counts?** The space type of the listing the HostCover plan covers, as Listings records it.

**A theft loss of 800.00 is being settled on a plan covering a Private Room listing. At what amount does the loss enter the settlement?** At 75 percent: 600.00, before any guest payment or deductible is subtracted. (Hypothetical figures.)

**And on a plan covering a Shared Room listing?** At 50 percent: 400.00.

**Does an Entire Guest Suite count as shared space?** No. Every space type other than Shared Room and Private Room is settled in full.
